item.ia_industries.cargo_copter.descript: A slow hauler built on the Quadrocopter. Hates wind.
item.ia_industries.cargo_gyrodyne.descri: A gyrodyne with a cargo bay and an engine. Burns fuel, lifts off vertically and takes a while to pick up forward speed.
item.ia_industries.cargo_biplane.descrip: A twin-engine Biplane with chests where the seats were.
item.ia_industries.cargo_seaplane.descri: A flying boat that carries its chests behind the cabin.
item.ia_industries.gigantia.description: Six engines and wings that never end. Lifts off easily, shrugs off wind, carries the most.
item.ia_industries.pelican.description: Fastest across the water, where all four engines run. It only leaves the water when you pull up firmly, and it is slow and clumsy in the air.
item.ia_industries.hawk.description: A gunship that ignores wind. The belly ballista deals double damage; the two underwing autocannons fire and hit 1.5 times as hard.
item.ia_industries.dragonfly.description: Two rotors on side booms and a vault slung under the belly. Burns fuel, lifts off vertically and accelerates slowly.
